comment: A third country to the common system of VAT of Directive 2006/112/EC,
article 5(2), which applies only in the territory of the Community as the
Treaties define it. Mozambique levies its own Imposto sobre o Valor
Acrescentado under Lei n.º 32/2007, de 31 de Dezembro, unrelated to the
Union's common system. `vat_prefix` is null: a Mozambican taxpayer is
identified by the Número Único de Identificação Tributária (NUIT), which the
Autoridade Tributária assigns and which carries no ISO country prefix
comparable to an EU VAT number.
territories.name: Mozambique
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and Mozambique is a third country to it. Mozambique levies a value added tax of its own, the Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado, under Lei n.º 32/2007, de 31 de Dezembro (Código do IVA), article 17, at a standard rate of sixteen per cent (16 %) and, under article 17-A, a reduced rate of five per cent (5 %).
